message: Account owner requests audit exports for Q4 compliance review.
resolution: Verify account owner, generate audit export, notify named customer success manager.

message: Customer requests refund on day 10 after processing 120 tickets.
resolution: Eligible under RFD-14 if no custom onboarding was delivered.

message: Workspace admin asks how long closed tickets remain available.
resolution: Growth retains closed tickets for 30 months under DRP-30.

message: Annual contract customer reports missed one hour urgent response target.
resolution: Review ENT-A9 service credit path and incident timeline.

message: User asks to delete attachments, ticket messages, and analytics records.
resolution: Deletion removes attachments first, then messages, then analytics aggregates in the nightly privacy job.

message: Customer wants audit exports without moving all agents to Enterprise.
resolution: Audit exports are Enterprise only; explain compliance feature boundary.
